mapper.sql: SELECT c.id, c.comment_id, c.doc_id, c.version_id, c.root_id, r.comment_id AS root_comment_id, c.author_user_id, c.body, c.created_at, c.deleted_at FROM kb_document_comment c LEFT JOIN kb_document_comment r ON r.id = c.root_id AND r.doc_id = c.doc_id AND r.version_id = c.version_id WHERE c.doc_id = #{documentId} AND c.version_id = #{versionId}

EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM kb_document_comment reply WHERE reply.comment_id = e.comment_id AND reply.doc_id = e.doc_id AND reply.version_id = e.version_id AND reply.root_id IS NOT NULL AND reply.deleted_at IS NULL)
mapper.select: AND c.comment_id = #{commentId} FOR SHARE OF c

INSERT INTO kb_document_comment (comment_id, doc_id, version_id, root_id, author_user_id, body, created_at) VALUES (#{commentId}, #{documentId}, #{versionId}, #{rootId}, #{authorUserId}, #{body}, #{createdAt}) RETURNING id

SELECT c.id, c.comment_id, c.doc_id, c.version_id, r.comment_id AS root_comment_id, (c.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) AS deleted FROM kb_document_comment c LEFT JOIN kb_document_comment r ON r.id = c.root_id AND r.doc_id = c.doc_id AND r.version_id = c.version_id WHERE c.doc_id = #{documentId} AND c.version_id = #{versionId} AND c.comment_id = #{commentId} AND c.author_user_id = #{authorUserId} FOR UPDATE OF c
mapper.update: UPDATE kb_document_comment SET body = NULL, deleted_at = GREATEST(CAST(#{deletedAt} AS timestamptz), created_at) WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO kb_comment_command (operation_domain, request_id, actor_user_id, doc_id, version_id, parent_comment_id, body_digest) VALUES ('COMMENT_CREATE', #{requestId}, #{actorUserId}, #{documentId}, #{versionId}, #{parentId}, #{bodyDigest}) ON CONFLICT (operation_domain, request_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT operation_domain, request_id, actor_user_id, doc_id, version_id, parent_comment_id, body_digest, comment_id FROM kb_comment_command WHERE operation_domain = 'COMMENT_CREATE' AND request_id = #{requestId}
